title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1+2 poste parkimi te perfshira ne Myslym Shyr
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1, në pallat me ashensor, në zonen Myslym Shyri, Tiranë.
* Sipërfaqe ~103 m²,siperfaqe neto 90m2
* Sallon i madh + kuzhinë me vete, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet, ballkon.
* Apartament i mobiluar, parket i ri, kondicioner.
* Kati 3‑të me pamje të mirë, orientim lindje dhe dritë natyrale.
* Zona qendrore, akses i lehtë, shërbime përreth.
*Disponon 2 poste parkimi ne kat -1 te perfshira ne cmim.
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2 parking spaces included in Myslym Shyr
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, in a building with an elevator, in Myslym Shyri area, Tirana. * Area ~103 m², net area 90m2 * Large living room + separate kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, balcony. * Furnished apartment, new parquet, air conditioner. * 3rd floor with good view, east orientation and natural light. * Central area, easy access, surrounding services. *There are 2 parking spaces on the 1st floor included in the price.
